title: Subscription to the International Development Association
what_it_is: Subscription to the International Development Association

sections.label: IDA allocations to four countries
sections.summary: Cambodia, Lao PDR, Myanmar and Vietnam received US$3.8 billion in the last replenishment round.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development and Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: In the last replenishment round, Cambodia, Lao PDR, Myanmar and Vietnam received a total of US$3.8 billion in allocations.

sections.label: Singapore IDA contribution share
sections.summary: Singapore raised its share from 0.08% to 0.15% and maintained it for the 17th replenishment.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development and Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: In 2010, we increased our share of contributions from 0.08% to 0.15% for the 16th round of replenishment.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development and Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: We maintained this share of 0.15% for the 17th replenishment exercise in 2013.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development and Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: Now, we have an upcoming 18th round of replenishment for IDA, and the majority of IDA donors have supported a total replenishment size of US$75 billion over the period of FY18 to FY20.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development and Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: This will enable IDA to double its core resources to countries in fragile and conflict-affected situations, as well as channel resources for crisis response and pandemic preparedness.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development and Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: To fund this 18th replenishment, IDA will, for the first time, also tap on capital markets to blend grant member contributions with market borrowings.

sections.label: Singapore burden share 18th replenishment
sections.summary: Singapore will maintain its burden share at 0.15%, amounting to US$46 million from MOF's budget.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development and Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: For this coming 18th round of replenishment, we will be maintaining our burden share at 0.15%.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development and Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: This was the same percentage as we had in the last round and translates into an amount of US$46 million from MOF's budget.

sections.label: Parliament approval for IDA subscription
sections.summary: Parliament's approval is requested to increase Singapore's total IDA subscription to not more than US$1.1 million.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development and Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: Under section 4(2) of the IDA Act, Parliament's approval is required for total IDA subscription exceeding US$1 million.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development and Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: We are, therefore, requesting that Parliament approve that the total subscription of Singapore to IDA be increased to a sum not exceeding US$1.1 million.
